description:
A technical writer organizing documentation has discovered that the file "/home/user/security_notes.txt" contains sensitive information such as passwords in plain text. Your task is to scan the file for any lines containing the word "password" (case-insensitive), replace those lines with the phrase "***REMOVED IN DOCUMENT REVIEW***", and save the updated file as "/home/user/security_notes_redacted.txt".

Additionally, create a report at "/home/user/redaction_log.txt" listing each replaced line, in the following format (one entry per line):

Original line: "<line content>"

For example, if a line is "Password: 123456", the log should contain:

Original line: "Password: 123456"

Make sure that the order in "redaction_log.txt" matches the order of appearance in "security_notes.txt".

Do not change any other content or formatting. The contents of "security_notes_redacted.txt" and "redaction_log.txt" will be checked for exact correctness.
